text: The Freudenthal suspension theorem in HoTT states (for n-connected A):
choices: Σ: πₙ(A) → πₙ₊₁(ΣA) is always an isomorphism
The suspension map is an equivalence below the stable range
A is contractible after n suspensions
ΣA is always n+1-connected and the suspension map is iso for k ≤ 2n
explanation: Freudenthal (HoTT): if A is n-connected, ΣA is (n+1)-connected and the suspension Ωₙ A→Ωₙ₊₁(ΣA) is an equivalence for k ≤ 2n.
